model_basis_rule: Model identity for a document is established in exactly one of two ways, and each entry says which:
pdf_text - the model string is printed inside the downloaded PDF (recorded as models_matched_in_text in the manifest).

manufacturer_page - the manual is series-based, prints the family with a shorthand, or does not print the model at all; the model is linked from the manufacturer's own product/support page recorded in source_page_url.

Model aliases are exact, curated strings. The app matches a model only when its normalised form equals a curated alias for that document - never by prefix, substring, or a part number found in the text.
Duplicate model strings are kept per document so one model can only ever resolve to the manuals that actually claim it.
notes: Entries marked disabled were attempted and are blocked (bot protection / JS-only support pages / wrong document). They stay in the file so the failure is visible.

Every enabled pdf_url was discovered on the manufacturer's own support page or their documented document host and then downloaded; data/acquisition_report.json records the raw result of every attempt.
Historical attempts whose entries were later replaced or dropped are recorded under historical_attempts in data/acquisition_report.json.
